cases.sentence: И ___, пророк, пошел в Рамот Галаадский.
cases.explain: «молодой человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So the young man, even the young man, the prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

cases.sentence: Я истреблю у Ахава всякого человека ___ — и раба, и свободного.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

cases.explain: «второго всадника» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them, and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’ ” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”
